digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI; Mgombato

teaser.en: A small orchid perched on a branch like a hen brooding on her eggs, which is exactly what its Digo name says.
teaser.sw: Okidi mdogo aliyekaa juu ya tawi kama kuku anayeatamia mayai yake, na hivyo ndivyo hasa jina lake la Kidigo linavyosema.
teaser.dg: *Orchid* ndide iriyosagala dzulu ya panda dza kuku asagalaye dzulu ya matumbige; ndivyo dzinare ra Chidigo rinavyogomba.

summary.en: *Chiahira* is the Digo word for epiphytes, plants that sit on other plants, and Pakia records it for this small coastal orchid. Mgombato records the leaves being used for earache.
summary.sw: *Chiahira* ni neno la Kidigo kwa vimelea, mimea inayokaa juu ya mimea mingine, na Pakia inalirekodi kwa okidi huyu mdogo wa pwani. Mgombato inarekodi kwamba majani yake hutumika kwa maumivu ya sikio.
summary.dg: *Chiahira* ni neno ra Chidigo ra mimea inayosagala dzulu ya mimea yanjina, na Pakia anariandika kpwa *orchid* hino ndide ya pwani. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika kukala makodzage nkuhumirwa kpwa kulumwa ni sikiro.

about.en: *Angraecum dives* is a small epiphytic orchid. It does not root in the soil but clings to the bark of trees and shrubs with its roots exposed to the air. It has short stems with two rows of narrow, leathery leaves and bears small pale flowers with a spur at the back. Digo identify it by the look of the whole plant.
about.sw: *Angraecum dives* ni okidi mdogo anayeishi juu ya mimea mingine. Haoti mizizi udongoni bali hushikamana na magome ya miti na vichaka, mizizi yake ikiwa wazi hewani. Ana mashina mafupi yenye safu mbili za majani membamba magumu kama ngozi, na hutoa maua madogo ya rangi hafifu yenye mrija mfupi nyuma. Wadigo humtambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg: *Angraecum dives* ni *orchid* ndide inayosagala dzulu ya mimea yanjina. Taimera mizi tsini ya tsi, ela inagbwira gopha ra mihi na ra vitsaka, na miziye inakala wazi hewani. Ina mihi mifupi yenye misitari miiri ya makodza membamba na magumu dza chingo, na inalavya maruwa madide ga ngushu-ngushu, genye mchira mdide nyuma. Adigo anaimanya kpwa kulola umbo ra mmea wosi.

where.en: It grows on the branches of trees and bushes in the coastal forests and thickets of Kenya and Tanzania.
where.sw: Huota kwenye matawi ya miti na vichaka katika misitu na vichaka vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.
where.dg: Inamera dzulu ya panda za mihi na za vitsaka, kpwenye matsaka na vitsaka vya pwani ya Kenya na Tanzania.

uses.en: Mgombato describes *chiahira* as a plant whose leaves are bruised and twisted into small plugs, which are put in the ear as a medicine for earache. Mgombato uses the word for this kind of plant in general and doesn't name a species.
uses.sw: Mgombato inaeleza *chiahira* kama mmea ambao majani yake huchubuliwa na kusokotwa kuwa vizibo vidogo, ambavyo hutiwa sikioni kama dawa ya maumivu ya sikio. Mgombato hulitumia neno hili kwa aina hii ya mimea kwa jumla na haitaji spishi.
uses.dg: Kamusi ya Mgombato inaeleza *chiahira* kukala ni mmea ambao makodzage nkuhopezwa na kusongoloswa, kuhenda vitu vidide vinavyoikpwa sikironi dza dawa ya kulumwa ni sikiro. Mgombato inahumira neno hiri kpwa mimea yosi ya aina hino, na taiandika aina mwenga hasa.

culture.en: Pakia explains that the name means 'sitting on'. *Ahira* is the word used for a hen sitting on her eggs, so the orchid is pictured brooding on its host tree. The prefix *chi-* marks its small size.
culture.sw: Pakia inaeleza kwamba jina hili lina maana ya 'kukaa juu ya'. *Ahira* ni neno linalotumika kwa kuku anayeatamia mayai yake, kwa hiyo okidi huyu anaonekana kama anaatamia mti unaombeba. Kiambishi *chi-* kinaonyesha udogo wake.
culture.dg: Pakia anaeleza kukala dzina hiri rina mana ya 'kusagala dzulu'. *Ahira* ni neno ra kuku anayesagala dzulu ya matumbige, kpwa hivyo *orchid* hino inaonekana dza kuku anayeahira dzulu ya muhi inaoumera. Mwandzo *chi-* unaonyesa kukala ni ndide.

names.en: *Chiahira* is not the name of one species but a group name. Digo call all epiphytic plants *chiahira* and do not give the different species their own names, even though they can see the differences. Pakia records it for two orchids, this one and the leopard orchid (*Ansellia africana*). Mgombato glosses it in Swahili as *kimelea*, a general word for plants that grow on other plants.
names.sw: *Chiahira* si jina la spishi moja bali ni jina la kundi. Wadigo huita mimea yote inayoishi juu ya mimea mingine *chiahira* na hawazipi spishi tofauti majina yao wenyewe, ingawa wanaweza kuona tofauti zao. Pakia inalirekodi kwa okidi wawili, huyu na okidi chui (*Ansellia africana*). Mgombato inalitafsiri kwa Kiswahili kama *kimelea*, neno la jumla kwa mimea inayoota juu ya mimea mingine.
names.dg: *Chiahira* si dzina ra aina mwenga, ela ni dzina ra fungu. Adigo anaiha mimea yosi inayosagala dzulu ya mimea yanjina *chiahira*, na taaipha chila aina dzinare, hata kala anaona tafwauti zao. Pakia anariandika kpwa *orchid* mbiri: hino, na *leopard orchid* (*Ansellia africana*). Kpwa Chiswahili, Mgombato inarieleza kukala ni *kimelea*, neno ra mimea yosi inayomera dzulu ya mimea yanjina.

conservation.en: Wild orchids of the Kenya coast depend on old trees in the coastal forests, and like all orchids they are listed under CITES Appendix II.
conservation.sw: Okidi wa porini wa pwani ya Kenya hutegemea miti mikongwe katika misitu ya pwani, na kama okidi wote, wameorodheshwa katika Kiambatisho II cha CITES.
conservation.dg: *Orchid* za weruni za pwani ya Kenya zinakuluphira mihi mikulu ya kare iriyo matsakani ga pwani, na dza *orchid* zosi, zikaandikpwa kpwenye CITES Appendix II.

reason.en: Mistletoe, another plant living on trees
reason.sw: Kimelea (*mistletoe*), mmea mwingine unaoishi juu ya miti
reason.dg: *Chibugu sicho kolo*, mmea wanjina unaoishi dzulu ya mihi

reason.sw: Mmea kimelea unaoota juu ya miti
reason.dg: Mmea unaomera dzulu ya mihi na kuifyondza

mgombato: chiahira (vi) parasitical plant whose leaves are bruised and made into twists to be inserted into the ear as medicine for earache; kimelea chenye majani ambayo yanayofyandwa na kuingizwa sikioni kama dawa ya maumivu ya sikioni.
